terms.latin: tabulā flūctivagā per summās undās prōlābī
terms.comment: flūctivagus, wave-tossed, is classical poetry (Stat.). The long ū follows de Vaan, who explains flūctus like flūxī; Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked.

sources: Lewis & Short: fluctivagus · Lewis & Short: prolabor
Michiel de Vaan, Etymological Dictionary of Latin and the other Italic Languages (2008), s.v. fluō.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 50.
